title: Odile and the Tide
author: Rosalind Iversen
blurb: Ines Pemberton, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
